Tool.Name: binding_search
Tool.Description: Ranked reflected binding discovery, including unavailable entries and their reasons.

Param.Name: module
Param.Description: Only bindings in this module or its sub-modules, e.g. editor or scriptcanvas.automation.

Tool.Name: binding_browse
Tool.Description: Browse editor automation bindings by module, then class or bus, then member. Each child reports its kind, tooltip and child count.

Param.Name: path
Param.Description: Dotted path of the level to list, e.g. scriptcanvas.automation.GraphAutomationRequestBus; empty lists the top-level modules.

Tool.Name: binding_open_module
Tool.Description: Add a typed tool to tools/list for every callable binding in a module and its sub-modules. Calls behave as binding_call.

Tool.Name: binding_close_module
Tool.Description: Remove the typed tools of an open module from tools/list.

Tool.Name: binding_describe
Tool.Description: Describe native signatures, defaults, types, scope and synchronous senders.

Tool.Name: binding_call
Tool.Description: Invoke one reflected overload or construct a class. Native calls are not generally undoable; failures report whether a call completed.

Tool.Name: binding_set
Tool.Description: Set a reflected property. General binding writes do not supply editor undo semantics.

Tool.Name: binding_release
Tool.Description: Release process-local object handles; context/owner changes also invalidate them.
